Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.controllers

Class StorageController

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.controllers.StorageController
@RestController @RequestMapping("api/v1/storage") public class StorageController extends Object
This controller handles HTTP requests related to storage operations. It interacts with the StorageServiceManagement to manage storage items.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
